card.title: Fine, What Does It Eat?
card.instruction: Accept the impossible premise immediately, then focus on its schedule, appetite, cleanup, safety, and long-term maintenance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The invisible guest can stay. Who takes the first feeding shift?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's immortal. I'm only house-sitting until Sunday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then show me your routine before you leave. I'll arrange permanent weekend cover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't know if it eats. I've just been leaving sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Label Sunday's sandwich. I'll check weekly, and put the sandwich checks in my will.

mechanism: A accepts an invisible immortal guest and plans permanent cover, then a durable way to test whether the guest eats.
confusable: Unlike celebrating a miracle or explaining its meaning, A focuses on recurring care and maintenance despite extreme duration.
comparison: This alternative preserves care through sandwich observation and a will; the dragon alternative coordinates school-day feeding and fire-safe surfaces.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
